nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence coordinated by Uganda's national health research organisation to strengthen clinical trial and research capacity across Eastern Africa. Tanzania's NIMR and KEMRI were partners alongside European…

nphi.title: ZikaPLAN – Zika Preparedness Latin American Network

nphi.title: Team Europe Initiative action: Fighting AMR and strengthening the One Health workforce in Africa
nphi.with: Africa CDC; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM); EDCTP; Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs; ICARS
nphi.summary: Team Europe action with Africa CDC, launched in Addis Ababa in May 2026 after a Danish-funded inception phase, in which ECDC, EDCTP and ASLM support AMR control and One Health workforce development in Africa.

nphi.title: EAVI – European-African Vaccine Initiative against chikungunya in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII); Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI, trial sponsor); Ifakara Health Institute (scientific lead); Valneva Austria; EPFL; Karolinska Institutet
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 partnership running a phase IIIb chikungunya vaccine trial in Kenya and Tanzania and preparing master protocols for future NTD vaccine trials; Spain's ISCIII and KEMRI participate.

nphi.title: ACT-PREP – Advancing clinical trials and epidemic preparedness research capacity in Africa

nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network building outbreak clinical-trial capacity embedded in national public health systems, working closely with Africa CDC.

nphi.title: PHAC–ECDC joint action plan
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: During a February 2026 visit to Stockholm, PHAC and ECDC adopted their first joint operational action plan, covering preparedness, risk assessment, epidemic intelligence, surveillance and training, and explored joint outbreak…

nphi.title: SPhIRhA – Strengthening Public Health Institutes for Resilience in Health in Africa
nphi.with: Africa CDC; national public health institutes of the four countries
nphi.summary: Sida-funded four-year project, coordinated by the Swedish agency together with Africa CDC, to strengthen four African NPHIs with a particular focus on sexual and reproductive health and rights.

nphi.title: ECDC MoUs with EU Enlargement countries
nphi.actor: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.with: Country signatories not named on the page
nphi.summary: MoUs signed in Stockholm on 28 April 2025 that formalise 14 years of cooperation. They cover information exchange on cross-border threats, observer participation in ECDC networks, and are a prerequisite for data-sharing agreements.

nphi.title: IANPHI–ECDC Memorandum of Understanding
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: In 2025, IANPHI and ECDC signed an MoU in Maputo. It covers preparedness and response, surveillance, training, climate impacts on communicable diseases, and communication.

nphi.title: AMR Contain – support to Ukraine
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; WHO Country Office Ukraine; regional CDCs; Kharkiv National Medical University; Zdorovi primary care network
nphi.summary: Supports Ukraine's national action plan on AMR and healthcare-associated infections. Work covers AMR and antibiotic-use data, stewardship, IPC guidelines, laboratory capacity and One Health coordination.

nphi.title: ECDC MoUs with Serbia, North Macedonia and Ukraine (2025)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia; Institute of Public Health of North Macedonia; Ministry of Health of Ukraine
nphi.summary: In 2025 ECDC signed memoranda of understanding with Serbia's and North Macedonia's institutes of public health and Ukraine's Ministry of Health, alongside those with other enlargement countries, to prepare them for EU integration of…

nphi.title: RER-CTO – Reinforcing the ethical and regulatory ecosystem for clinical trials oversight in Ethiopia and Tanzania

nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project strengthening ethics committees and regulators in Ethiopia and Tanzania through framework mapping, digital review systems, training and joint review guidelines; Tanzania's NIMR is a partner.

nphi.title: ECDC–Japan memorandum of cooperation
nphi.with: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of Japan; Japan Institute for Health Security (JIHS); National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID)
nphi.summary: Memorandum of cooperation signed in Tokyo in October 2024 covering epidemic intelligence, AMR, vaccines, risk communication, training and preparedness, formalising earlier exchanges with NIID.

nphi.title: Health resilience in the Eastern Partnership – preparedness and response component
nphi.actor: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (mental health and workforce components); national public health authorities of the Eastern Partnership countries
nphi.summary: EU-funded initiative in which ECDC helps the Eastern Partnership countries assess and strengthen their preparedness for serious cross-border health threats. The work includes regional simulation exercises, workshops, webinars, an expert…

nphi.title: ODIN – Strengthening environmental surveillance to advance public health action

nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project piloting genomic wastewater and environmental surveillance of pathogens and AMR genes in Burkina Faso, DRC and Tanzania, with Finland's THL and Tanzania's NIMR as partners.

nphi.title: EU-WISH – EU Wastewater Integrated Surveillance for Public Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health; Statens Serum Institut (supporting organisation); partners from 26 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action with partners in 26 countries (incl. non-EU Norway and Ukraine) to strengthen wastewater-based surveillance of biological and chemical agents.

nphi.title: ECDC–Gulf CDC collaboration
nphi.with: Gulf Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (Gulf CDC); Gulf Health Council
nphi.summary: Collaboration since 2022 on EOC development and knowledge management; a June 2025 visit to ECDC agreed to deepen work on preparedness, surveillance and epidemic intelligence and to formalise the partnership.

nphi.title: UKHSA–ECDC Memorandum of Understanding
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed on 1 December 2021 by Jenny Harries and Andrea Ammon to cooperate on epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, lab capacity for emerging threats, AMR and healthcare-associated infections.

nphi.title: ECDC – KDCA memorandum of understanding
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: MoU to deepen technical collaboration on communicable disease control and health security, covering epidemic intelligence, preparedness, surveillance, AMR, zoonoses and training through information and expert exchange.

nphi.title: Global Laboratory Leadership Programme (GLLP)
nphi.with: WHO; ECDC; FAO; WOAH (OIE); Association of Public Health Laboratories; implementing countries incl. Pakistan and Liberia
nphi.summary: CDC co-developed the Global Laboratory Leadership Programme with WHO, ECDC, APHL, FAO and WOAH. Its One Health learning package trains national laboratory leaders and has been rolled out in countries including Pakistan and Liberia.

nphi.title: Africa CDC–ECDC antimicrobial stewardship training in Gabon
nphi.with: Africa CDC (incl. Central Africa Regional Coordinating Centre, Libreville); Ministry of Health Gabon
nphi.summary: September 2025 national One Health antimicrobial stewardship training in Lambaréné, co-organised by Africa CDC, ECDC and Gabon's Ministry of Health with a Gabon-adapted curriculum, under the AMR work package of the Africa CDC–ECDC…

nphi.title: Africa CDC–ECDC R data-analysis training for Rwanda Biomedical Centre experts
nphi.with: Rwanda Biomedical Centre (RBC); Africa CDC
nphi.summary: May 2025 hands-on R training for 15 RBC surveillance experts using local datasets, delivered with Africa CDC under the Africa CDC–ECDC partnership project as a pilot for country-specific trainings in other AU member states.

nphi.title: IANPHI 2025 annual meeting session on climate change and disease
nphi.with: Fiocruz; Santé publique France; Gesundheit Österreich (GÖG); IEDCR Bangladesh; Public Health Agency of Sweden
nphi.summary: Session where Fiocruz, Santé publique France (chair of the IANPHI Climate Thematic Committee), Austria's GÖG and Bangladesh's IEDCR shared COP29/30, heat-health monitoring and flood experiences.

nphi.title: ECDC technical assessment of Kosovo communicable disease surveillance

nphi.title: KDCA – US CDC – IANPHI Asia-Pacific pandemic surveillance capacity workshop
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA, host); IANPHI; ECDC; UKHSA; ACPHEED; health authorities of 10 Asia-Pacific countries

nphi.title: ODIN-Mpox – Wastewater and environmental surveillance for mpox in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Université de Kinshasa (scientific lead); University of Helsinki; Ghent University; VIB; CNRST-IRSS; University of Oxford; NORCE
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project applying genomic wastewater and environmental surveillance to track mpox in the DRC and neighbouring countries, with Tanzania's NIMR as a beneficiary.

nphi.title: China CDC – ECDC technical exchange on public health workforce training
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: An online exchange in January 2024 on EPIET/EUPHEM and China's CFETP and public health training, with intent to keep sharing information on workforce development.

nphi.title: 2024 IANPHI Europe Regional Network Meeting (Budva)

nphi.summary: Montenegro's IPH hosted European NPHIs and ECDC to discuss climate and health, research preparedness for emergencies, conflict-related AMR and regional collaboration.

nphi.title: Gates-funded Integrated Disease Surveillance project
nphi.with: INS Mozambique; NIH Pakistan; others not named
nphi.summary: In 2022, IANPHI ran a Gates-funded study of integrated disease surveillance. It made country deep dives in Mozambique, Pakistan, Malawi, Uganda, England, Sweden and Canada, and held a webinar with NIH Pakistan and INS Mozambique.

nphi.title: EU for health security in Africa: ECDC for Africa CDC
nphi.with: Africa CDC
nphi.summary: EU-funded (EUR 9 million to ECDC plus EUR 1 million to Africa CDC) four-year capacity project in which ECDC supports Africa CDC on preparedness and emergency operations, harmonised surveillance and epidemic intelligence, and public health…

nphi.title: ECDC–Mexico Ministry of Health memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Mexico
nphi.summary: MoU signed in June 2021 between ECDC and Mexico's Ministry of Health on public health cooperation.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: ECDC IPA6 project – One Health AMR and SARI surveillance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye
nphi.with: National public health institutes of the six Western Balkan beneficiaries and Türkiye
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded ECDC technical assistance (2020–2024) on One Health antimicrobial resistance and enhanced SARI surveillance, bringing Western Balkan and Turkish experts into ECDC networks such as E-SARI-Net as observers.

nphi.title: Establishment of Somalia National Institute of Health
nphi.with: Federal Ministry of Health and Human Services Somalia; National Institute of Health Somalia; WHO Somalia; NIRAS Sweden AB
nphi.summary: Sida-funded support led by FHM to set up an independent Somali NIH, working with WHO under a non-financial MoU signed in December 2020. Areas covered include workforce, surveillance, emergency response and health information.

nphi.title: Saudi CDC – Public Health Agency of Sweden cooperation agreement
nphi.actor: Saudi Center for Disease Prevention and Control (Weqaya)
nphi.with: Public Health Agency of Sweden (Folkhälsomyndigheten)
nphi.summary: A 2019 agreement covering workforce and organisational development, institutional strategy, specialised microbiology laboratories, health economics, communicable and non-communicable disease control, and healthy lifestyles.

nphi.title: Joint WHO Europe–IANPHI seminars on building NPHIs through mergers
nphi.with: Public Health Center of Ukraine; WHO Regional Office for Europe; merged NPHIs of Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden, UK
nphi.summary: WHO Europe and IANPHI held three seminars, in Kyiv (2017), Warsaw (2018) and Moldova (April 2019). Merged NPHIs from Belgium, France, Norway, Sweden and the UK shared their experience with countries setting up NPHIs: Ukraine, Moldova,…

nphi.title: Public Health Agency of Sweden–China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: The two agencies signed an MoU in 2015 and cooperate on infectious disease control.

nphi.title: ICMR – FORTE Memorandum of Intent
nphi.with: Swedish Research Council for Health, Working Life and Welfare (FORTE)
nphi.summary: Memorandum of intent for joint health and welfare research funding.

nphi.title: IANPHI Leadership Academy for African NPHI leaders
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INS) Mozambique; National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania
nphi.summary: IANPHI launched a Leadership Academy in 2014 with backing from Sweden's NPHI and the Gates Foundation. INS Mozambique and NIMR Tanzania gave local support, and a Kenyan participant went on to become a Heymann Fellow.

nphi.title: ECDC–Israel CDC administrative agreement
nphi.with: Israel Center for Disease Control (ICDC)
nphi.summary: Administrative agreement concluded in 2012 between ECDC and Israel's Center for Disease Control.

nphi.title: ECDC–US CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
nphi.summary: One of ECDC's first international MoUs, signed in 2007 with the US CDC to cooperate on communicable disease prevention and control.

nphi.title: ECDC–PHAC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2007 between ECDC and the Public Health Agency of Canada on cooperation in communicable disease control.

nphi.title: ECDC–China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: Since a 2007 MoU, ECDC and China CDC have cooperated on epidemic intelligence and response, syndromic surveillance for mass gatherings, preparedness and AMR.

nphi.title: V-RESIST – reducing inappropriate antibiotic use in Viet Nam
